fields.description:
Observed while fixing a3f5-5c19-faad-417b (2026-08-22): on a clean origin/main checkout (8481a057b69, and reconfirmed with no local diff) on a macOS dev host, tests/unit/workflow/test_bridge_provider_wrappers_heldout.py::test_five_environment_matrix_has_identical_results_without_gh fails for all 5 params (local/github/jenkins/gitlab/bare vendor envs) while 6 other tests in the file pass and CI's Verified gate is green on the same tree.

ROOT CAUSE (proven per /rebar-debug): not gh itself — agent harnesses on dev hosts export command-scope git config through the environment (GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=2, GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=safe.bareRepository, GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=explicit, GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1=credential.interactive, GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1=never). The bridge harness helpers `git()`/`bare_git()` in tests/scripts/test_run_reconcile_bridge.py inherit os.environ wholesale, so the injected safe.bareRepository=explicit makes the verification call `git -C <bare tickets-origin.git> show ...` fail with "fatal: cannot use bare repository ... (safe.bareRepository is 'explicit')". CI has no such env vars, so it stays green. Discriminating experiment: unsetting only GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/KEY_*/VALUE_* makes all 5 params pass on the same tree. The same gap breaks tests/scripts/test_run_reconcile_bridge_heldout.py and tests/interfaces/facades/test_bridge_runner_install_paths_heldout.py (21 failures total) on such hosts.

PLAN (test-only):
1. In the shared harness tests/scripts/test_run_reconcile_bridge.py, add a scrub of ambient command-scope git-config injection (GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/GIT_CONFIG_KEY_*/GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_*/GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS) and pin GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null + GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 in the git()/bare_git() helpers and the workspace-setup git subprocesses; scrub the injection vars from runner_env() so the bridge run under test is also held out from ambient host git config.
2. In test_five_environment_matrix_has_identical_results_without_gh, monkeypatch the hostile injection (GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1, GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=safe.bareRepository, GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=explicit) unconditionally, so the matrix exercises the hostile ambient state deterministically on every host including CI — strengthening the held-out contract, not weakening it (the gh PATH hold-out is untouched).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Root cause of the host-vs-CI divergence confirmed per /rebar-debug (proven: ambient GIT_CONFIG_* command-scope injection of safe.bareRepository=explicit reaching the harness's inherited-env git subprocesses; discriminating unset experiment flips all 5 params to pass).
- [ ] Test passes on a host WITH gh installed and authenticated (and with the GIT_CONFIG_* injection present) — proven by `python -m pytest tests/unit/workflow/test_bridge_provider_wrappers_heldout.py -q` locally.
- [ ] No weakening of the held-out contract (the matrix must still prove gh-independence) — mutation check: symlinking gh into the matrix fake_bin makes the test fail.
- [ ] The strengthened matrix test is RED against the unfixed harness even in a clean environment (deterministic regression coverage in CI, not just on hostile hosts).
- [ ] Sibling sweep: tests/scripts/test_run_reconcile_bridge_heldout.py and tests/interfaces/facades/test_bridge_runner_install_paths_heldout.py pass on the hostile host via the shared-harness fix.

## Testing
Reproduce: run `python -m pytest tests/unit/workflow/test_bridge_provider_wrappers_heldout.py::test_five_environment_matrix_has_identical_results_without_gh -q` on a dev host with GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=safe.bareRepository / GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=explicit exported (as agent harnesses do). Verify the fix with the same command plus `python -m pytest tests/scripts/test_run_reconcile_bridge.py tests/scripts/test_run_reconcile_bridge_heldout.py tests/interfaces/facades/test_bridge_runner_install_paths_heldout.py -q`; RED-determinism by reverting the harness change and re-running the matrix test in a clean env (must fail); gh-independence mutation check by adding "gh" to the fake_bin symlink list (must fail).
